result.summary: The image shows a residential street with a poorly maintained sidewalk that is obstructed by a parked vehicle and litter. There is a complete lack of pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, signals, or lighting, creating a hostile environment for walking.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A black SUV is parked partially on the sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, mid-ground.

hazards.name: Poor Sidewalk Condition
hazards.description: The sidewalk surface is cracked, uneven, and covered with debris, creating tripping hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and mid-ground on the right side.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Maintenance
interventions.description: Resurface the sidewalk to provide a smooth, accessible path and implement regular cleaning to remove debris.

interventions.title: Parking Enforcement and Curb Management
interventions.description: Install bollards or higher curbs to prevent vehicles from parking on the sidewalk and blocking pedestrian access.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Improvements
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks and pedestrian-scale lighting to improve visibility and safety for people crossing the street.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and curb ramps with tactile warning pads. However, safety is compromised by faded crosswalk markings, poor pavement condition, and a lack of visible dedicated pedestrian signals.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven asphalt in the roadway and near the crossing area.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalks using high-visibility 'continental' or 'ladder' patterns to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and curb ramps with tactile warning pads, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the wide roadway creates a long crossing distance without refuge islands, increasing exposure to vehicle traffic in a mixed-use urban environment.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide intersection requires pedestrians to be in the roadway for an extended period without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection may obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbside to the left and right of the intersection

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the wide roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in two stages.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the crosswalk to improve sightlines.

result.summary: The image shows a mixed-use urban street with a sidewalk but no visible formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure at the intersection. The presence of parked vehicles along the curb creates potential sightline obstructions for pedestrians attempting to cross the two-lane roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the visible intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross without a designated space.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area in the background left

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the right side of the roadway

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.
